[版本1.0]

Z_图像_至 SDXL

这可能是动漫的工作流程。

我见过像 SDXL 到 Z-image-Turbo 这样的精炼器，但我尝试了相反的工作流程。

前端Ksampler使用Z-image-Turbo，后端Ksampler使用SDXL。 （在这里，我不是特别推荐 WAI-illustrious-SDXL v14.0；这取决于你。）

在本例中，降噪值暂时设置为 0.6，因此适当调整它应该会产生结果。

正面提示很常见，但负面提示仅在 SDXL 中可用。

至于Optional Positive（用于SDXL），可以将其与一些好的想法一起使用，但可能没有必要。

我还没有尝试过 NSFW 或现实内容。

使用两个自定义节点：

https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

https://github.com/LEv145/images-grid-comfy-plugin

[Ver1.0a]

Z_image_to SDXL+ LLM

Added LLM using LMStudio.

LM Studio - Local AI on your computer

(This function requires LMStudio to be installed and running)

Additional Custom Nodes

ALatentPlace/YANC_LMStudio: A ComfyUI integration to use LMStudio for extending prompts.

[Ver1.0]

Z_image_to SDXL

This is probably an anime workflow.

I've seen refiners like SDXL to Z-image-Turbo, but I tried the opposite workflow.

Z-image-Turbo is used on the front-end Ksampler, and SDXL on the back-end Ksampler. (Here, I'm not particularly recommending WAI-illustrious-SDXL v14.0; it's up to you.)

In this example, the denoise value is set to 0.6 for now, so adjusting it appropriately should produce results.

Positive prompts are common, but negative prompts are only available in SDXL.

As for Optional Positive (for SDXL), use it with some good ideas, but it might not be necessary.

I haven't tried it with NSFW or realistic content yet.

Two custom nodes are used:

https://github.com/yolain/ComfyUI-Easy-Use

https://github.com/LEv145/images-grid-comfy-plugin
